Jupiter placed in the 1st house (Lagna) produces excellent outcomes, as Jupiter is the greatest natural benefic in Jyotish. The native is handsome in appearance — Jupiter's grace expressed through the house of physical self. Fortunate life circumstances are conferred. Long life is granted. The native is fearless. Children are present. Jupiter in the Lagna shapes the entire personality with Jupiter's expansive, wise, and generous qualities. The first house under Jupiter's influence makes the native a person of physical and personal grace. This is one of the most auspicious Lagna placements in classical Jyotish, producing a well-rounded positive outcome across health, fortune, family, and character. Handsome, fortunate, long-lived, fearless, blessed with children.

Jupiter, the minister of the Gods, when endowed with all surpassing strength (maximum Shadbala, own sign, or exaltation, not combust, brilliant with full rays) and posited in the Lagna — can singlehandedly ward off many evils which would otherwise be very difficult to overcome. This is one of the most powerful single-planet protective configurations in the entire chapter. Singlehandedly wards off many evils difficult to overcome.

For Virgo (Kanya) lagna, Jupiter is lord of 07th house and it is the badhaka. This is because Virgo is a dual (dwi-swabhava rashi) sign. Jupiter also functions as maraca as it is lord of 07th house.

Jupiter governs wealth and abundance. In the 7th it concerns partnerships. Donating clothes (a Jupiter-governed article) from this position returns as deprivation — the native and family pine for clothes.

Jupiter placed in the 7th house (Kalatra Bhava — house of spouse) produces very favorable outcomes. The wife and sons are of good quality. The native is very amiable — extremely pleasant and congenial in nature. The native is more munificent (generous) than their father — an indication that the native surpasses the previous generation in charity and generosity, a distinguished quality in classical Indian social values. Jupiter in the 7th, as a natural benefic in the house of partnership, elevates all partnership significations: the quality of the spouse, the harmony of the marital relationship, and the native's own generous and agreeable personality as expressed through partnerships. Good wife and sons; very amiable; more munificent than father.

When Jupiter occupies the 7th house and is in depression (Neecha — Capricorn/Makara), the native's wife will die. Jupiter debilitated in the 7th removes the protective benefic influence from the spouse's house. This occurs for Cancer Lagna natives (7th house = Capricorn). Death of wife.

D) For Virgo, Mercury becomes lagna lord. If it is in 08th house, viz. Aries and un-connected to a badhaka signifying planet, it shall offer good longevity. F) If Mercury is in 05, 09, 08 houses and not linked to badhaka signifying planet it can offer good longevity.

When the Sun is positioned in the 11th house, various influences can shape the outcomes in an individual's life. If Jupiter casts its aspect on this placement, it may lead to multiple marriages, with the first wife potentially not bearing any sons. A strong Sun in this house often indicates a tendency to socialize with women. However, if there are aspects from both the Sun and Mars, the individual might face a range of chronic health issues. A debilitated Sun could suggest heart ailments, complications related to the reproductive system, and possible fatal accidents such as drowning or falls. Afflictions from malefic planets can bring about neurological disorders and financial struggles. If the Sun is in Cancer, it may indicate a higher likelihood of having sons. Conversely, if the Sun is in its own sign or if the Moon is also in the 11th house, this could result in significant wealth. Lastly, if the Sun is in Aquarius, it may be associated with having children.

The Sun placed in the 11th house (Labha Bhava — house of gains) produces excellent outcomes. The native is very wealthy and long-lived. Kingly status is attained. The native is free from sorrow and suffering. The 11th house is a house of gains, fulfillment, and income — the Sun here converts its solar authority into material abundance and prosperity. The absence of sorrow is notable — the 11th placement insulates the native from major suffering. The long life indication contrasts with the 8th house placement's shortened lifespan, confirming the 11th as a highly auspicious house for the Sun. Very wealthy, long-lived, King, free from sorrow.
